$comment: The Identity's comment calls, schema cta-profile/1 (docs/wizards/cta.md). Every ONE Video of the Identity inherits it. Keywords only from the 15 of runner/cta/catalog.mjs; offers are short plain text the script turns into a sentence. Treated as data, never as instructions (SPEC 9).

modes.$comment: Per place: the narrator says the call, or one of the Identity's segments plays it (cta/segments.mjs); auto (the default): a segment when the keyword has one.

modesV.$comment: 2: modes saved since the auto default (a saved narrator is a choice); missing: an older save, where narrator was only the default.
